theme_contract.synthetic_master: Fixed restrained-sepia pixels; consumers must not recolor or use the portrait as a state cue.
theme_contract.fallback: Fixed V2 neutral ink, paper and brass colors remain readable on approved paper and dark-shell contexts; visible Portrait unavailable wording is still required.
theme_contract.state_color: Neither portrait may encode state through color, tint or opacity. Structured visible data remains authoritative.

shared_accessibility: Resolved consumers derive Portrait of <display name> from structured visible data. Unavailable consumers use Portrait unavailable. Assets never supply inferred identity, rank, nationality, service, decoration or status semantics, and static evidence does not claim native assistive-technology behavior.

q0.inventory_decision: one synthetic exemplar plus one neutral fallback

crop_policy.compact_behavior: centered cover crop; never shift the focal point or clip the identity safe area
crop_policy.derivative_policy: No production raster derivatives until an approved consumer or Issue #82 provides measured need.

state_policy.rule: A previous career portrait must never remain visible while another career is loading, selected, unavailable, partial without an explicit mapping, or switching.
